test_title: PYST 4: DP Head Constable (AWO/TPO) 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 28 Oct 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit to the right of D. Only two people sit to the left of C. Only two people sit between D and G. Only three people sit between C and E. A is not an immediate neighbour of D. B sits to the right of D. Who sits at the extreme left?
solution:
Given:

Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

Only two people sit to the right of D. Only two people sit to the left of C.

Only two people sit between D and G. Only three people sit between C and E.

A is not an immediate neighbour of D. B sits to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7caf43cd32bf1d7e128279ea617869cc8d949db4d55e595ff6867edf9491bb07.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83815080abb2e5eb5c85413210383167ded92c13c206198db12369bbf35fe3db.png] 

Thus, A sits at the extreme left.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
